rules: An asserted placement names exactly one asset and one locus; non-asserted whereabouts states omit the current locus and never use sentinel identifiers.
Observed placement requires observation and ingestion times, source, precision and precision method, and confidence.
Planned placement requires both a scenario and governing basis.
Planned and observed episodes may coexist only with an explicit divergence assertion when their loci disagree.
Placement mode, record status and whereabouts state are independent closed enumerations and cannot be substituted for one another.
Unknown, withheld, never-observed, absent and disposed remain distinct; a last-known locus is separately time-qualified.
Every correction creates an immutable record-time version with versionId, assertedAt and record interval; prior effective versions remain queryable as-of record time.
Episode succession uses supersedesRef and is separate from the previousVersionRef version chain.
One asset cannot have overlapping effective observed placements at mutually exclusive loci of the same granularity.
A gap between episodes means only no asserted placement; it never implies absence, disposal or non-placement.
locusKind is closed over place, site, facility and building; interior space is deferred to incomplete WM-BLT-002; granularity is distinct from measurement precision.
Address, geometry overlap, shared address and reporting boundary never imply containment or placement.
Placement never grants or proves custody, title, operational responsibility, access, occupancy, availability or maintenance completion.
Corrections and supersessions preserve provenance and history; custody, ownership or responsibility changes never silently rewrite placement.
Personal and sensitive loci are generalized or withheld under the referenced disclosure policy.
Projection behavior is governed only by the shared Landscape Projection definition and does not add identity.
sharedProjectionRules: Every projection pins each source version and record-as-of time, declares projection-as-of, purpose, disclosure policy and deterministic digest.
A projection has no independent domain identity and cannot request a registry or runtime identifier.
Output never refines source granularity or precision and cannot reconstruct a withheld locus.
Cross-rendition composition or differencing that weakens disclosure is forbidden.
Aggregates enforce the disclosure-policy suppression threshold, including small-cell protection.
Withheld is emitted as an explicit marker distinct from absent, unknown, disposed and never-observed.
Availability is derived only for a stated purpose and as-of instant and is never stored as a timeless fact.
Placement never implies responsibility, custody, title or access, and work order plus responsibility never implies completion.
